MECHANISM: a one-index list subscript emits `(p-aref-deref SRC IDX)` with a SCALAR index -- the `$aref->[i]` hot path, which returns the element (undef) -- and at run time it is indistinguishable from `my @x = ($r->[0])`, which perl answers with ONE undef.  So the fix is COMPILE-TIME: in Pl/ExprToCL.pm gen_array_ref_access_form, a `list_ctx_subscript` node in LIST context (not lvalue) emits its index as `(vector IDX)`, which reaches #2953's empty-source arm.  Emission-changing (every one-index list slice in list context): measure corpus-diff and the slices bench row.  Guard: list-slice-01.t, perl-oracle rows for (@e)[0], (@e)[-1], (f())[0] with f returning (), and the unchanged (1)[5] (one undef) / $r->[0] in a list.
